in_sanskrit.name: Randheer
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Ruler of the Thunderbolt
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Randheer एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Randheer is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘rādhā-dhīr’ meaning ‘one who is ruled by Radha’. Radha is the consort of Lord Krishna and is considered the epitome of love and devotion. The name Randheer signifies someone who is ruled by love, and is therefore, a courageous, handsome and brave individual.
